column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A to NIST Cybersecurity Framework v2.0 Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A reference controls and NIST CSF v2.0 Functions, Categories and Subcategories (GV/ID/PR/DE/RS/RC). Per the publicly available NIST CSF Informative Reference to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 mapping. Class-level anchors connect catalogue concepts; per-control rows map AnnexAControlId permissible values to CSF subcategory CURIEs. Predicates - skos:closeMatch where one CSF subcategory substantively addresses the Annex A control objective; skos:relatedMatch where coverage is partial.
